## Description and Rationale

SMAC is made of a group of young data scientists that share a strong interest in using data to solve practical problems and uncover meaningful insights. We are excited by the opportunity to combine our different perspectives, strengthen our analytical skills, and develop a creative, evidence-based solution through the data challenge.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: Canada
* Number of team members: 3
